messages:
tay: Hi all, first day! I accepted the org invite but when I try to open a private repo I get a banner that says 'You must authorize SSO for this organization' and a big 'Request access' button. I clicked authorize but it just spins. Anyone run into this? my GH username is taycodes and email tay@redwood.ai

devex: welcome @tay! that SSO banner usually means you accepted the invite with a different GH account or GH app token needs reauth. Did you accept with the same account that has your work email verified?

tay: i'm 95% sure I accepted with taycodes (personal account) but my work email is added to it. I thought that was fine.

sam-identity: If you're using SAML SSO for the org you need to explicitly authorize access for the account you're using. On github.com go to Organization -> Your organizations -> Redwood Inference -> Authorize SAML SSO (there should be a blue button). If it failed to finish, try clearing cookies or an incognito window.

alan-it: Also check Settings -> Applications and Authorized OAuth Apps; revoke any old tokens from "redwood-ci" if they show as unauthorized. The spinning authorize sometimes happens when an old CI token is blocking the handshake.

github-bot: SAML SSO reauthorization requested for taycodes by sam-identity.

tay: tried incognito, clicked Authorize SAML SSO and it redirected to company login, I signed in, then landed back on GH but still shows "Authorize SSO".

sam-identity: Are you using the same email on both accounts? if your personal GH is primary for taycodes but the org expects tay@redwood.ai as primary/verified email, GH can behave oddly. You can add and verify the work email on the taycodes account and then re-run the authorize flow.

tay: my work email is listed but not primary. I just made it primary and reattempting.

alan-it: If that doesn't work, accept a fresh invite sent to the exact account email (we can resend). Also sometimes admins set "block outside collaborators" which requires full org membership vs outside collaborator access. We'll check your invite type.

github-bot: New org membership invite issued to taycodes (tay@redwood.ai) by alan-it.

tay: ok I accepted the new membership invite and just clicked Authorize SAML SSO again... it worked, the banner is gone and I can open the private repo. cloning now.

devex: nice! quick note for others: prefer accepting invites from your work account; add and verify work email on GH if you want to use an existing personal username. we'll add this to the onboarding doc.

sam-identity: filing a quick ticket to check if any invites were created as outside collaborator vs member for the last batch. thanks for the fast triage everyone.

tay: thanks y'all, appreciate the help :)
